subject.title: skill_workshop proposals are agent-scoped in list/inspect/lifecycle actions despite shared on-disk store — cross-agent verification impossible

question: Should Skill Workshop proposals be globally discoverable across agents on one Gateway, with lifecycle mutations separately authorized, or should per-agent ownership remain intentional with a documented administrator/reviewer path?
rationale: The shared on-disk index conflicts with the reported session-scoped tool and CLI behavior, but filesystem location alone does not establish the intended cross-agent authorization model.

options.title: Shared discovery, gated mutation
options.body: Make list and inspect complete for the authorized gateway/reviewer scope while retaining explicit authorization checks for apply, reject, and quarantine.

options.title: Retain agent scoping with admin path
options.body: Keep ordinary agent proposals scoped but document that behavior and add a supported administrator or owner-targeted inspection and lifecycle interface.

recommendation.title: Shared discovery, gated mutation
recommendation.body: Make list and inspect complete for the authorized gateway/reviewer scope while retaining explicit authorization checks for apply, reject, and quarantine.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier report supplies the clearest available evidence of the repeated workflow failure; a code-area owner should be identified before implementation.
